---
title: "Class results"
subtitle: "How did everyone's calculations compare?"
toc: false
---

After each deadline your instructor releases the anonymized class results here: the median signed error of every method for every reaction, across all submissions. Use them to check your own numbers and to see patterns no single student could see alone.

::: {#class-results}
*Loading class results…*
:::

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import { h, loadJSON } from "./components/core.js";

const root = document.getElementById("class-results");
const course = await loadJSON("data/course.json").catch(() => ({ experiments: {} }));
const released = Object.entries(course.experiments || {}).filter(([, v]) => v.release_class_results);
if (!released.length) {
  root.replaceChildren(h("p", { class: "lab-muted" }, "No class results have been released yet. Check back after the first deadline."));
} else {
  const Plot = await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/+esm");
  root.replaceChildren();
  let draftPicks = null;
  const leagueErr = {};
  const leagueExps = new Set();
  for (const [id] of released) {
    let data, exp;
    try {
      [data, exp] = await Promise.all([loadJSON(`data/class/${id}.json`), loadJSON(`data/experiments/${id}.json`)]);
    } catch (e) { continue; }
    const cells = [];
    for (const [cond, byRxn] of Object.entries(data.stats)) {
      const [mid, bid] = cond.split("|");
      const m = exp.methods.find((x) => x.id === mid);
      for (const [rxn, s] of Object.entries(byRxn)) {
        const bl = exp.bases.find((x) => x.id === bid);
        cells.push({ method: exp.bases.length > 1 ? `${m?.label ?? mid} / ${bl?.label ?? bid}` : (m?.label ?? mid), reaction: rxn, median: s.median, n: s.n, q1: s.q1, q3: s.q3 });
      }
    }
    const max = Math.max(1, ...cells.map((c) => Math.abs(c.median)));
    const order = [...new Set(cells.map((c) => c.method))];
    const heat = Plot.plot({
      title: `Experiment ${exp.number}: median signed error (kcal/mol), ${data.n} submissions`,
      width: 760, height: 60 + 24 * order.length, marginLeft: 140, padding: 0.04,
      x: { label: null, axis: "top" }, y: { label: null, domain: order },
      color: { type: "diverging", scheme: "RdBu", domain: [-max, max], reverse: true, legend: true, label: "median ε (kcal/mol)" },
      marks: [
        Plot.cell(cells, { x: "reaction", y: "method", fill: "median", tip: true, channels: { n: "n", "25%": "q1", "75%": "q3" } }),
        Plot.text(cells, { x: "reaction", y: "method", text: (d) => d.median.toFixed(1), fontSize: 10 }),
      ],
    });
    const sec = h("section", { class: "lab-card", style: "margin-bottom:1.5rem" }, h("h2", {}, exp.title), heat);
    if (data.methods_chosen && Object.keys(data.methods_chosen).length) {
      sec.append(h("h3", {}, "Methods the class chose"),
        h("table", { class: "res-table compact" },
          h("thead", {}, h("tr", {}, h("th", {}, "method / basis"), h("th", {}, "students"), h("th", {}, "median signed error"))),
          h("tbody", {}, Object.entries(data.methods_chosen).sort((a, b) => b[1].n - a[1].n).map(([k, v]) =>
            h("tr", {}, h("th", {}, k), h("td", { class: "num" }, String(v.n)), h("td", { class: "num" }, v.median_error == null ? "—" : v.median_error.toFixed(2)))))));
    }
    if (data.draft) draftPicks = data.draft;
    for (const [cond, byRxn] of Object.entries(data.stats)) {
      if (!["ex03", "ex04", "ex05"].includes(id)) break;
      const mid = cond.split("|")[0];
      const lbl = exp.methods.find((x) => x.id === mid)?.label ?? mid;
      for (const s of Object.values(byRxn)) (leagueErr[lbl] = leagueErr[lbl] || []).push(Math.abs(s.median));
      leagueExps.add(exp.number);
    }
    if (data.muddiest?.length) {
      sec.append(h("h3", {}, "Muddiest points (anonymous)"), h("ul", {}, data.muddiest.slice(0, 12).map((t) => h("li", {}, t))));
    }
    root.append(sec);
  }
  // Functional draft (picked in Experiment 3): class-median MAE over every
  // released reaction of Experiments 3-5.
  if (draftPicks) {
    const rows = Object.entries(leagueErr).map(([m, v]) => ({ method: m, mae: v.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / v.length, picks: draftPicks[m]?.picks ?? 0 }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.mae - b.mae);
    root.prepend(h("section", { class: "lab-card", style: "margin-bottom:1.5rem" },
      h("h2", {}, "🏆 Functional draft league"),
      h("p", { class: "lab-small lab-muted" }, `Ranked by the class-median MAE over all released reactions of Experiment${leagueExps.size > 1 ? "s" : ""} ${[...leagueExps].sort().join(", ")}.`),
      h("table", { class: "res-table compact" },
        h("thead", {}, h("tr", {}, h("th", {}, "#"), h("th", {}, "method"), h("th", {}, "students who drafted it"), h("th", {}, "class-median MAE"))),
        h("tbody", {}, rows.map((r, i) => h("tr", {}, h("td", { class: "num" }, String(i + 1)), h("th", {}, (i === 0 ? "🥇 " : i === 1 ? "🥈 " : i === 2 ? "🥉 " : "") + r.method), h("td", { class: "num" }, String(r.picks)), h("td", { class: "num" }, r.mae.toFixed(2))))))));
  }
}
</script>
```
